metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 8 inches in Canberra, Australia during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (mm/day) over a 10 km buffer around Canberra point (-35.2809, 149.13) for 2020-01-14 to 2020-01-23 (end-exclusive). If empty, fallback to PERSIANN-CDR Daily.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (precipitation product). Rely on dataset masks; validate valid pixel count after summation.
3. Logic: Sum daily precipitation, compute regional mean (mm), convert to inches. If collection empty → C1; if valid pixel count = 0 → C2; if null/NaN/negative → C3; else compare > 8 inches for A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const canberraPt = ee.Geometry.Point([149.1300, -35.2809]);
    const region = canberraPt.buffer(10000); // 10 km buffer
    const start = '2020-01-14';
    const end = '2020-01-23'; // end-exclusive to include Jan 22
    const scale = 5000;
    const inchThresh = 8;
    const mmPerInch = 25.4;

    function analyzeDataset(collectionId, band) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(region)
        .select(band);

      const size = col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        return {dataset: collectionId, size: 0, pixels: 0, totalMm: null};
      }

      const sumImg = col.sum(); // mm summed over period per pixel
      const pixCount = sumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(band).getInfo();

      if (!pixCount || pixCount === 0) {
        return {dataset: collectionId, size: size, pixels: 0, totalMm: null};
      }

      const meanTotalMm = sumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(band).getInfo();

      return {dataset: collectionId, size: size, pixels: pixCount, totalMm: meanTotalMm};
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let res = analyzeDataset('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY', 'precipitation');
    let usedFallback = false;
    if (res.size === 0) {
      usedFallback = true;
      const res2 = analyzeDataset('NOAA/PERSIANN-CDR', 'precipitation');
      res = res2;
    }

    console.log(`Region: Canberra AU (10km buffer)`);
    console.log(`Dates: 2020-01-14 to 2020-01-22`);
    if (usedFallback) console.log(`CHIRPS empty -> Fallback to PERSIANN-CDR`);
    console.log(`Dataset: ${res.dataset}`);
    console.log(`Images: ${res.size}`);

    if (res.size === 0) {
      console.log(`No data in date/location.`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    if (!res.pixels || res.pixels === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid Pixels after processing: 0`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const totalMm = res.totalMm;
    if (totalMm === null || totalMm === undefined || isNaN(totalMm) || totalMm < 0) {
      console.log(`Calculation invalid: totalMm=${totalMm}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const totalIn = totalMm / mmPerInch;
    console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${res.pixels}, Scale: ${scale} m`);
    console.log(`Total Rainfall (mm): ${totalMm.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Total Rainfall (in): ${totalIn.toFixed(2)}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (totalIn > inchThresh) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err);
    console.log(`Error: ${msg}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
